# vesopasoftware.com
#
# Replaces HestiaCP's autogenerated file, which sat in public_html and set
# Crawl-delay: 10 on a site we want indexed. public_html is no longer served at
# all — every request goes to the Node app — so this is the file that answers.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The client portal is private: sign-in, invoices, project files and the
# message thread. Nothing under it should be indexed, and none of it is
# reachable without a session anyway.
Disallow: /portal
Disallow: /api

Sitemap: https://vesopasoftware.com/sitemap.xml
